title: How big is the connected TV advertising market?

facts.fact: IAB and Guideline project U.S. connected TV ad spending to grow 11% to $29.3 billion in 2026 (a forecast, not an observed full-year total).
facts.quote: IAB and Guideline project connected TV ad spending to grow 11% to $29.3 billion.

facts.fact: eMarketer's August 21, 2026 forecast says U.S. connected TV ad spend will reach $36.95 billion in 2026; it is a forecast using a different definition from the IAB figure.
facts.quote: U.S. connected TV ad spend "will" reach $36.95 billion in 2026

facts.fact: The IAB series gives U.S. connected TV ad spend of $20.3 billion for 2023, a Guideline estimate of spend rather than a forecast.
facts.quote: Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend in the IAB series. This is an estimate of spend, not a forecast.

facts.fact: The IAB series gives U.S. connected TV ad spend of $23.6 billion for 2024, a Guideline estimate about 16% above 2023.
facts.quote: Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend, about 16% above 2023.

facts.fact: The IAB report says connected TV ad spend grew about 12% in 2025 and that social video overtook connected TV in spend during 2025.
facts.quote: The IAB report says social video overtook connected TV in spend during 2025, and that connected TV growth that year was about 12%.

facts.fact: Guideline's 2026 estimate for combined U.S. digital video ad spend (connected TV, social video, and online video) is $81.9 billion, up 11% from the prior year.
facts.quote: Guideline's 2026 estimate for that combined market is $81.9 billion, up 11% from the prior year.

facts.fact: In MediaPost's account of the IAB report, social video is forecast at $31.9 billion in 2026, up 13%.
In MediaPost's account of the IAB report, online video is forecast at $20.7 billion in 2026, up 10%.
The IAB report expects digital video to account for more than 60% of all TV and video ad spend in 2026; the chart marks the 2026 share at 61%, against 58% in 2025.
facts.quote: The chart marks that 2026 share at 61%, against 58% in 2025.

facts.fact: The IAB Digital Video Ad Spend and Strategy Report's full version was published July 14, 2026, after part one in May 2026.
MediaPost describes a survey of 360 media executives fielded by Advertiser Perceptions in February and March 2026 in the IAB report; these are buyer opinions, not dollar totals.
facts.quote: MediaPost describes a survey of 360 media executives fielded by Advertiser Perceptions in February and March 2026.

facts.fact: Adwave says its campaigns use a prepaid daily budget starting at $30, and Google Search is included from that $30 minimum.
facts.quote: Adwave campaigns use a prepaid daily budget from $30.

facts.fact: Adwave's published budget ladder lists Reddit as opening at $35 a day.
Adwave's published budget ladder lists TikTok at $91 a day, and TikTok is not in the default live channel mix.
facts.quote: **$91 a day:** TikTok, when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: Earlier versions of this page cited eMarketer forecasts of $33.35 billion for 2025 and $37.95 billion for 2026; both were forecasts, and the 2026 figure was superseded by the $36.95 billion August 2026 forecast.
facts.quote: Older sentences on this page treated eMarketer's $33.35 billion (2025) and $37.95 billion (2026) figures as the size of the market.

facts.fact: The IAB report's prose says connected TV is forecast to grow 11% in 2026 while social video's 2026 growth is 13%.
facts.quote: The IAB report's own prose says connected TV is forecast to grow 11% in 2026, and that social video's 2026 growth is 13%.

facts.fact: The page reports no observed full-year 2026 connected TV ad spend total; both the IAB and eMarketer 2026 figures are forecasts.
facts.quote: No new observed full-year total for 2026 has been released.
